en: The front of the postcard shows a colored photographic view of a harbor and cityscape with the text 'Sundsvall. Utsikt från Stadsparken över Hamnen.' suggesting the image is a view from the city park over the harbor in Sundsvall, Sweden. The scene includes various ships in the harbor, industrial buildings, and a lush park in the foreground. The reverse side of the postcard shows handwritten text in Swedish, an address to 'Fröken Alva Styqvist, Köpmangatan 8, Östersund', and a partially visible postmark.
